name: valid-round
description: Fix-loop assist (#127): is this gate round a valid measurement, or did the instrument or the capture invalidate it? Runs on the round's verdict lines and capture notes; an invalidated round does not spend the iteration cap.

fields.round: { page, width, label, verdict: the gate.sh verdict lines, captureNotes: stitch / font / challenge warnings, exitCodes: { pixel, contentDiff, visualDiff, chromeParity, clip } }

instructions.question: Do the lines in `round` show that an instrument failed to measure — a deadline, a capture error, a missing root line, a stitch seam or wrap, a compare that did not run?
instructions.focus: Exit 124, 'no verdict', 'capture failed', 'DEADLINE', 'ERROR', a doc height that changed between two reads, a stitched image shorter than the document.

criteria.true: At least one instrument reported it could not measure.

instructions.question: Do the lines show the live origin was not in a steady state when captured — a bot challenge or 403, a consent or marketing overlay still open, hydration placeholders, a carousel mid-transition, a height that differs from the previous round's live capture?

criteria.true: The origin side changed or was blocked between or during captures.
criteria.false: The origin capture is the cached one or reads steady.

fonts_fallback_loaded.instructions: Do the lines show a declared web font that failed to load or a fallback face rendered on either side (a FontFace status error, a font-fork warning, a 'fonts not loaded' note)?

instructions.question: Given `round`, should this round count against the three-iteration cap — a valid measurement of the prototype the agent changed?
instructions.focus: A round counts when the pixel verdict is real and the build was re-captured after a fix; it does not count when an instrument or the origin invalidated it, or when nothing changed on the build since the previous round.

criteria.true: A real measurement of a changed build.
criteria.false: Invalidated by an instrument or the origin, or no build change since the last round.
